notes.title: Writers Version 1.01
notes.content:
In version 1.01:

[b]1. Random Mode.[/b]
We added the Random mode to the game, which you can select for a multiplayer match.
When Random Mode is selected, a random match will be created. Also, you automatically connect to the game, if there is already created match by other players. We hope that this will help to compete in multiplayer, as long as there is not a large enough player base.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31032517/b973be1de57023afd0c5b060c93f70d5947d93c2.png[/img]

[b]2. 48 Leaderboards.[/b]
For each League and Game Mode, we made its own statistics and leaderboards.
Game modes have 3 indicators:
[list]
    [*]CPM Max - the maximum CPM for all time.
    [*]CPM Avg - average CPM, considering all matches.
    [*]Skill - victory points.
[/list]
In addition, we want to add the same indicators to the Statistic section of the game. What for? Why not.

[b]3. More than 1000 quality texts.[/b]
We took beautiful literary works, then manually selected the texts, so that everything looked organic in the game.
List (English and Russian leagues):
[list]
    [*] «Dracula», Bram Stoker;
    [*] «Moby Dick; or, The Whale», Herman Melville;
    [*] «Pride and Prejudice», Jane Austen;
    [*] «The Picture of Dorian Gray», Oscar Wilde;
    [*] «A Hero of Our Time», Mikhail Lermontov;
    [*] «Dead Souls», Nikolai Gogol;
    [*] «The Brothers Karamazov», Fyodor Dostoyevsky;
    [*] «The Captain's Daughter», Alexander Pushkin;
    [*] «The Queen of Spades», Alexander Pushkin.
[/list]

Also fixed many bugs that sometimes did not allow to write text and finish the match.
If you notice a bug, write to the writersthegame@gmail.com, we will immediately try to fix it.

In the near future there will be a lot of cosmetic fixes and improvements.

Thanks to all who wrote the feedback, it is very important to us!

notes.title: Priority tasks for Writers
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our priorities for this week:
[olist]
    [*][u]Add Random Mode.[/u] This is not a separate game mode. Random Mode will be in the same place as the other modes when you select a game in a multi-player menu and allow you to connect to already created matches, regardless of the mode. It is necessary that you can play in multiplayer, as now there are very few players and it is impossible to search for an opponent in 16 modes.
    [*][u]Make honor boards and statistics for each game mode.[/u] Now there are 3 indicators for each league (6 in total): Skill - Victory Points, Cpm - Average Characters per Minute, Cpm Max -
 maximum Cpm of all time. Because of this, you can not get the Cpm in certain modes: Duel, Duel Hard, Numbers, Fixed. Because adding these scores ​​to the average Cpm from all modes will be dishonest. Task: add another 49 leaderboards so each mode has its own statistics.
[/ olist]

To all of the above, we will start to promote the game, since the launch was without advertising. Thanks to everyone who bought Writers and even left a positive review!

We will do everything possible to make you easily find a match and shot another graphomaniac in a duel. :)
